title: Mo' Punkins! II
description: Mo' Punkins! II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Yakov Smearnov

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 16 Punkins on the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Yakov Smearnov

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 16 Punkins on the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

I'll tell you what. These Punkins are really getting on my nerves! If I never have to send you out to kill more of them it would be a good day. But, it is a good day because I get to send you out to kill more of them!

Run along to the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and wipe out the required number of these Punkins. Slay the Punkins and return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

You smashed them, right? That is the only fate befitting these vile squatters! Let me know when you want to do this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Slay Punkins

Level range: 92–100
